description: Curated colimit owner / comparison registry. Every declaration reference is validated against the current Lean source by tools/infra/colimit_ledger.py. A canonical_equiv claim may only exist as a named Lean declaration.

status_vocabulary.canonical_owner: designated owner for a category-specific realization
status_vocabulary.specialization: narrower interface over the same Mathlib universal construction
status_vocabulary.supplied_cocone: carrier and maps are data; no universal property is asserted
status_vocabulary.quotient_realization: explicit quotient presentation with a proved lift/universal property
status_vocabulary.inverse_system: dual/inverse system of functionals or projections
status_vocabulary.completion: analytic completion of an algebraic direct limit
status_vocabulary.categorical_preservation: Mathlib preservation comparison, not a new carrier
status_vocabulary.apex_uniqueness: generic theorem identifying two colimiting cocones over one diagram

entries.title: Filtered direct-limit owner (ModuleCat, RingCat)
entries.diagram: filtered small J-indexed diagrams
entries.notes: Generic category-filtered owner. The ModuleCat lane exposes carrier, injections, descent, stage commutativity and descendDirectLimit_unique; the RingCat lane has descendDirectLimitRing_unique. SequentialModule remains a narrower N-indexed specialization.

entries.title: Sequential ModuleCat colimit interface
entries.diagram: N-indexed diagrams
entries.notes: Carrier is exactly Mathlib `colimit F`; the header states no second quotient implementation is introduced. descend_unique is the module-lane uniqueness theorem that the generic filtered owner lacks.

entries.title: Tensor product preserves ModuleCat colimits
entries.diagram: arbitrary J-indexed ModuleCat diagrams
entries.notes: Reusable preservation family; tensorColimitIso_ι is the stage-injection coherence theorem.

entries.title: Filtered colimits of abelian groups commute with finite (co)limits
entries.diagram: filtered J-indexed diagrams
entries.notes: Uses Mathlib `colim` and PreservesKernel/PreservesCokernel; no new carrier.

entries.title: Infinite observable algebra as a RingCat colimit
entries.diagram: filtered finite sub-region diagrams
entries.notes: tomita_takesaki_colimit is conditional on a supplied natural isomorphism `F ≅ F_commutant`; it transports an existing stage-wise isomorphism along HasColimit.isoOfNatIso.

entries.title: Generic apex uniqueness for two colimiting cocones
entries.diagram: a single diagram with two supplied IsColimit witnesses
entries.notes: This is the existing generic comparison theorem the proposed ColimitFusion interface would re-export; the underlying owner is InfoGeometry.Canonical.CategoryTheoryConeUniqueness.colimitCocone_apex_inversePair. It requires two actual IsColimit witnesses and does not manufacture a colimit.

entries.title: UHF bitword/diagonal boundary cylinder colimit
entries.diagram: N-indexed diagonal algebra embeddings
entries.notes: CylinderColimit is a set of functions, not a completed operator algebra. DiagAlg is a commutative diagonal (MASA-like) stage, not a full matrix stage; do not identify it with a matrix/UHF limit.

entries.title: Quotient presentation of the finite matrix stage inductive limit
entries.diagram: N-indexed full matrix stages with stageMor-phisms
entries.notes: Explicit quotient of the disjoint union of stages with liftStarAlgHom and liftStarAlgHom_unique as the star-algebra universal property. Retained as a proven matrix-tower presentation; compare with CuntzMatrixAlgebraicStarColimit and with the BitWord presentation through MatrixStageFullColimitEquivalence.

entries.title: Equivalence of BitWord-indexed quotient and matrix direct-limit presentations
entries.diagram: comparison between two presentations of one finite matrix tower
entries.notes: Proved star-algebra equivalence with both round-trip theorems and stage laws. Header states it identifies only the two algebraic colimit presentations, not completions or functionals. This is the model comparison for other algebraic lanes.

entries.title: Cuntz matrix algebraic star colimit (direct-limit carrier)
entries.diagram: N-indexed matrix stages, Mathlib DirectLimit
entries.notes: Carrier is the Mathlib DirectLimit-based finite matrix stage tower with transported algebra/star structure.

entries.title: UHF categorical colimit (Ring.DirectLimit of DiagAlg)
entries.diagram: N-indexed diagonal algebra embeddings
entries.notes: Ring.DirectLimit carrier. Relation to the finite matrix tower and to the cylinder boundary representation is a separate comparison obligation.

entries.title: Filtered star-algebra direct limit
entries.diagram: filtered directed I-indexed star-algebra systems
entries.notes: Canonical noncommutative algebraic star-algebra owner with stage maps and universal lift.

entries.title: Cl(1,1) tensor tower limit
entries.diagram: N-indexed Cl(1,1) tensor stages
entries.notes: Limit is built from Mathlib DirectLimit; star structure and algebra operations are transported from stages with explicit compatibility theorems.

entries.title: Cl(1,1) tensor inductive limit package
entries.diagram: N-indexed tensor stages, aliasing the Clifford owner limit
entries.notes: Thin packaging over InfoGeometry.Clifford.Cl11TensorTowerLimit.Limit; no second carrier introduced.

entries.title: Elementary direct and inverse colimit interface
entries.category: Module R direct systems; dual inverse systems; ModuleCat
entries.diagram: preorder-indexed direct systems with compatible cocones
entries.notes: Owns the elementary DirectInductiveSystem/InductiveCocone presentation, its native ModuleCat readout, and the dual inverse transition. Global functionals are compared with compatible finite-stage dual families.

entries.title: Native filtered/inverse readouts for the Cl(1,1) tower
entries.diagram: Cl(1,1) finite matrix stages with stageEmbedMap
entries.notes: Packages the existing finite matrix tower into the ModuleCat filtered interface. limitReadout is a module map from the native colimit to the Cl11 DirectLimit carrier; it is not yet a ring/star isomorphism. Header states no second colimit carrier is introduced.

entries.title: Tensor colimit expectations and compatible functional families
entries.diagram: N-indexed tensor towers with supplied carrier and injections
entries.notes: TensorInductiveLimit is supplied carrier data with compatible injections. The header explicitly refrains from asserting a C-completion or universal property. Must not be promoted to a universally characterized colimit without a new owner theorem.

entries.title: Filtered isometric Hilbert completion (generic)
entries.diagram: filtered isometric direct systems
entries.notes: Generic analytic owner: algebraic direct limit, completion map, isometry, dense range, completeness.

entries.title: Filtered GNS Hilbert colimit
entries.diagram: compatible filtered family of noncommutative states
entries.notes: Instantiates the generic isometric Hilbert owner; stage images generate densely. Identification with another completed representation needs a compatible isometry plus dense-image/surjectivity proof.

entries.title: Native ModuleCat cocone for the split Clifford tower
entries.diagram: split Clifford linear direct system
entries.notes: Presents the tower via ModuleCat.directLimitCocone with an IsColimit proof; the Spectral/Colimit/Basic.lean header names this file the colimit owner.

entries.title: Inductive colimit KMS/GNS bridge
entries.category: Module R systems; GNS inner product; modular flow
entries.diagram: preorder-indexed inductive systems with compatible states
entries.notes: Colimit descent of modular flow and KMS boundary states; checked algebraically over supplied cocones.

entries.title: KMS state lift capstone over a colimit boundary
entries.category: state functionals on a module colimit boundary
entries.diagram: compatible stage states
entries.notes: Uses the bridge owner definitions; capstone packaging only.

entries.title: Tensor tower colimit compatibility (finite chain/cone)
entries.diagram: N-indexed modules with iota and psi cone data
entries.notes: The file itself states no theorem asserts a universal-property, topological, or analytic colimit result; it is a chain/cone compatibility owner.

entries.title: Erlangen colimit invariant resolution
entries.diagram: N-indexed ring chains with bonding intertwiners
entries.notes: Resolves colimit inheritance of invariants from an explicit ambient algebra and global embedding; the ambient data is supplied.

entries.title: Normalized trace transport across full-matrix colimit presentations
entries.diagram: finite matrix stages and direct-limit carrier
entries.notes: Kernel-checked normalized-trace compatibility between existing quotient and categorical full-matrix colimit presentations; no new carrier or completion is introduced.

entries.title: Split-Clifford Fock action closure on the direct-limit carrier
entries.diagram: split Clifford and Fock direct-limit stages
entries.notes: Associativity of the descended Fock action with direct-limit Clifford multiplication; this is a representation closure theorem, not a new colimit construction.

comparisons.notes: Round-trip star-algebra equivalence between the two full-matrix presentations, with stage compatibility lemmas. Treat as the worked model for other algebraic comparisons; do not rebuild.

Module-level readout from the native ModuleCat colimit into the Cl11 DirectLimit carrier, plus normalized-trace readout. Multiplication/star/grading coherence of this readout is a separate open obligation.
Mathlib preservation comparison with stage coherence.
Dense generation of the completed GNS Hilbert colimit by stage images; completeness is also proved. This is a completion relation, not an equivalence with an arbitrary ambient representation.

Both expose Mathlib `colimit` on ModuleCat diagrams; for N-indexed diagrams the carriers are the same construction. Canonicalization action is a thin re-export/unification, not a new carrier or a new universal property.
KMS/modular-flow descent on the colimit boundary; checked over the bridge owner definitions.
Finite diagonal observables pass to compatible cylinder families on the Cantor boundary. This is a function-space readout, not an algebra completion or a matrix-tower equivalence.

gaps.description: Resolved by the generic ModuleCat uniqueness theorem `descendDirectLimit_unique` in FilteredDirectLimitOwner; the narrower SequentialModule theorem remains a specialization.
gaps.suggested_next: Keep the registry and generated ledger synchronized; pursue the separate sequential-filtered interface comparison next.

gaps.description: SequentialModule and FilteredDirectLimitOwner both wrap the same Mathlib colimit for ModuleCat diagrams. Make one the canonical surface and expose the other as a compatibility alias with a named declaration; avoid two competing public interfaces without a comparison.
gaps.suggested_next: Add a re-export theorem/abbrev (e.g. SequentialModule.Carrier = FilteredDirectLimitOwner.DirectLimitModule for N-indexed diagrams) with a source-level identity proof, or mark one interface as the compatibility alias in its header.

gaps.description: The Cl(1,1) lane has a native ModuleCat colimit (Cl11FilteredInductiveInverseColimitBridge.nativeModuleColimit) and a DirectLimit carrier with transported multiplication/star (Cl11TensorTowerLimit.Limit). limitReadout is only a module map; no source-level theorem in the registered owners states that it preserves multiplication, star, or grading, and no inverse/iso is registered.
gaps.suggested_next: State the comparison goal as a star-algebra homomorphism (or equivalence, if an inverse exists) from the ModuleCat colimit carrier to Limit, with a stage law; prove multiplication and star compatibility from ofStage_apply_bond and the transported instances.

gaps.description: TensorColimitExpectation.TensorInductiveLimit is explicitly supplied carrier data without a universal property. Any downstream use that treats it as the universal tensor colimit is a categorical conflation until an owner proves the universal property (or a comparison to a genuine colimit).
gaps.suggested_next: Either prove the universal property for a concrete tensor tower instance, or add an explicit compatibility theorem mapping the supplied carrier to the genuine colimit owner (TowerColimit/FilteredDirectLimitOwner).

gaps.description: FilteredGNSHilbertColimit is a completed Hilbert colimit with dense stage images. Identification with any other completed GNS representation requires a compatible isometry and a dense-image (or surjectivity) proof; no such comparison is registered.
gaps.suggested_next: If a second completed representation exists for the same state family, state the isometry and prove dense range from the existing dense_iUnion_range lemma and stage naturality.

gaps.description: UHFCategoricalColimit uses Ring.DirectLimit of DiagAlg, while UHFInductiveColimitBoundary realizes the diagonal observables as cylinder functions on CantorBoundary. The registered owners contain a transport (diagonal_uhf_colimit_synthesis) but no registered algebra isomorphism between these two carrier presentations; any identification needs a named comparison theorem preserving multiplication.
gaps.suggested_next: Search consumers first; if needed, construct the evaluation map from Ring.DirectLimit to cylinder functions and prove it is a ring homomorphism with the expected stage law, or record the one-way morphism explicitly.

gaps.description: Spectral.Colimit.NativeModuleColimit provides the Mathlib directLimitCocone/IsColimit owner for the split Clifford tower, while Cl11 owners use a DirectLimit carrier. The relationship between these two presentations for the overlapping tower is not registered as a comparison theorem.
gaps.suggested_next: Check whether these towers are the same diagram; if yes, state the comparison through the two universal properties rather than unfolding carriers.

guardrails: APEX UNIQUENESS: TypedCategoryArchetype.colimitCoconePairDatum_apex_inversePair requires two actual IsColimit witnesses over one diagram; it identifies cocone apexes and does not construct a colimit.
SUPPLIED COCARE: TensorColimitExpectation.TensorInductiveLimit and ErlangenColimitResolution ambient data are supplied structures; they must not be cited as universal colimits.

DIAGONAL VS FULL MATRIX: UHFInductiveColimitBoundary.DiagAlg is a commutative diagonal algebra; MatrixStageInductiveLimit/CuntzMatrixAlgebraicStarColimit are full matrix towers. Their relationship is inclusion/expectation, not equivalence unless a named theorem proves it.
CYLINDER SET: UHFInductiveColimitBoundary.CylinderColimit is a set of functions on CantorBoundary, not a completed C-algebra or a topological colimit.
TENSOR TOWER FILE SCOPE: Canonical.TensorTowerColimit asserts chain/cone compatibility only; its own header denies universal-property, topological, or analytic colimit claims.
NO NEW GENERIC OWNER: the generic comparison interface proposed in the audit already exists as TypedCategoryArchetype.apex uniqueness plus Mathlib colimit API; it should be re-exported, not rebuilt.
CANONICAL_EQUIV EDGES: this registry must not gain a `canonical_equiv` comparison without a named Lean declaration reference; semantic similarity is not an equivalence proof.
